verses.1: And Jacob saw that there was food in Egypt. So he said to his sons, “Why do you stay here?”
verses.2: And he said, “Now I have heard that there is a place in Egypt where we can find shelter. Let us go there and be saved from here. Then we will live, and we will not die.”
verses.3: And the people of Joseph went down to Shubar from Egypt.
verses.4: And Jacob did not send his brothers away. He said, “They will only call us ‘accursed.’”
verses.5: And the children of Israel came to Shibor, because of the famine that was in the land of Canaan.
verses.6: And Joseph was the ruler over the land. He was the one who caused destruction to all the people of the land. Then Joseph’s brothers came and bowed down to him.
verses.7: And Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them. He greeted them warmly and spoke to them about their situation. He said to them, “From where do you come?” They replied, “From the land of Canaan, to seek food.”
verses.8: And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.
verses.9: And Joseph remembered the dreams he had, and he said to them, “You are destined to see the wonders of this land.”
verses.10: And they said to him, “We are not your servants, and your people have come to destroy your food supply.”
verses.11: We are all children of one man. We are ready to serve you. We were not your servants in the past.
verses.12: And he said to them, “Is it not true that the land is full of suffering when you come here to see it?”
verses.13: And they said, “Twelve of your servants are brothers. We are children of one man in the land of Canaan. Now, today, the youngest one has taken away our father; the other one does not remain with us.”
verses.14: And Joseph said to them, “This is the one I told you about: ‘You will be rulers.’”
verses.15: In this way, we will see the life of Pharaoh. Whether they will come out of here or not, it depends on our little brother who is here right now.
verses.16: Send one of you, and let him take our brother away. Then you will be forbidden to speak the truth to each other. And if Pharaoh does not live, then you will be punished.
verses.17: And he gathered them together in the place of sacrifice, for three days.
verses.18: And Joseph said to them, “On the third day, do this. Then you will live and worship God. I will be afraid.”
verses.19: If you are brothers, then one of you must be forbidden to stay in your house. Go and bring food for your hungry brother.
verses.20: And bring your little brother to me. Let us hear what he has to say. Do not let him die. And so it was done.
verses.21: And they said to each other, “But we must punish our brother who saw his suffering and still did not listen to us when we pleaded with him. So this suffering came upon us.”
verses.22: And Reuben said to them, “I told you not to sin against the child. But you did not listen. And now, his blood is demanded.”
verses.23: And they did not know that Josaphat had heard what was being said among them.
verses.24: And He took them away from above them, and He sat down among them. He spoke to them, and He took their shalom from them, and He prevented it from being seen by their eyes.
verses.25: And Joseph commanded that their containers be filled with wine. Then, each person was given their share of wine to drink. He also provided them with provisions along the way. And so it was done.
verses.26: And they carried their wounds on their shoulders, and they left that place.
verses.27: And one of them opened his bag to give his money to the merchant. He saw that it was gold coins.
verses.28: And he said to his brothers, “Return to me. Look, I am still alive.” They were afraid and rushed to tell their brother, “What has God done to us?”
verses.29: And their father came to Jacob in the land of Canaan. They told him everything that had happened to them.
verses.30: The words of this man, the ruler of the earth, were difficult for us. He treated us like slaves, making us work hard on the land.
verses.31: And they said to him, “We are not worthy of this.”
verses.32: Twelve years ago, we were brothers. Our father is no longer alive. Today, the younger one is with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.33: And the man said to us, “Adonai of the earth.” In this way, I will know that you are truly our brothers. Let him who has left me behind and his hunger go away from among you.
verses.34: And bring your little brother to me. I know that you are not lying; you truly intend to take care of your brother. Then I will give you the land to sell.
verses.35: And their bags became empty. Then, a man came along with his bag in his hand. He saw the contents of their bags, as well as those of their ancestors. They were terrified.
verses.36: And Jacob said to them, “My father, you have chosen me. But Shechem and Zebulun are not suitable for me. Take Benyamin instead.”
verses.37: And Reuben said to his father, “Kill my two sons if I do not bring them back to you. Then I will hand them over to you. I will return them to you.”
verses.38: And he said, “Do not bring me down with you, my son. For his brother has died, and he is left alone. They will call him Asen along the path you will take. And you will bring back my remains in a jar.”
